notes.quarterly_gdp_2026: NSO quarterly year-on-year estimates for Q1-Q3 2026, from the official Q3 and first-nine-months release; not GDP level observations.
notes.sectors: World Bank NV.AGR.TOTL.CD, NV.IND.TOTL.CD, NV.SRV.TOTL.CD; definitions are broad value-added groups.
notes.monthly_gdp: Cubic spline is only a compatibility series for the current dashboard; do not use it as observed monthly GDP in backtests.
notes.cpi_monthly: NSO PXWeb E11.07 index observations and monthly CPI release rates are stored separately. Release rates are copied as published; never converted into index levels or backfilled across base changes.
notes.quarterly_gdp_refresh: Quarterly GDP growth is a separate NSO release series and is not rewritten by the annual World Bank updater.
notes.fx_monthly: IMF ER monthly average rate in VND per USD; latest observed period returned in this refresh is 2026-08.
notes.grdp_local: GRDP levels derived from NSO GRDP per-capita (million VND/person) multiplied by NSO average population (thousand persons), yielding billion VND. The six region aggregates are shown beside their constituent provinces; do not sum both levels.
notes.trade_frequency: Historical merchandise trade is annual through the latest NSO table year; 2026 monthly preliminary exports and imports are supplied separately in du_lieu_xuat_nhap_khau_thang_2026.csv.
notes.retail_frequency: Historical retail is annual; the 2026 monthly file contains monthly estimates and official cumulative real growth rates. The cumulative real growth column is not a monthly rate.
notes.iip_frequency: Annual IIP uses prior-year=100 indexes (2012-2025); 2026 monthly IIP uses 2015=100. These are separate grains and bases.
notes.fdi_comparability: Annual NSO E04.11 observations begin in 1991 because the source groups 1988-1990 into one three-year total stored separately in du_lieu_fdi_giai_doan_1988_1990.csv. Historical registered capital is licensed project capital; the 2026 cumulative registered total includes new registration, adjustments, and capital contributions/share purchases, so those definitions are not directly comparable.
notes.modeling: Never use cubic-spline monthly GDP values as observed targets for ADF, training, or test metrics. Forecast evaluation uses observed annual real GDP only.
